title: GOLD SCISSORS AND THE QUIET WORK
passages: A trip into the wilderness. Long hours in my own head. A new pair of gold scissors. A sewing machine. The work was changing shape again.

Sewing gave me another place to practice patience and solve problems with my hands. I made pieces for myself and the squad, with mentors willing to help me learn. Fabric offered a tangible answer to an emotional question: what do I want to make of this time, this energy, this version of myself?
